blocks.h: What an unapproved plot can cost
paras: Without approval you may be refused a building permission, a bank loan and, in some cases, utility connections. Regularisation schemes exist from time to time but are not guaranteed. A cheaper plot can become the expensive one.

Ask for the approval number and authority, then confirm with the authority itself. See [DTCP vs PPA](/guides/dtcp-vs-ppa-approval-pondicherry). For layouts we promote near the highway, such as those around [Tindivanam road](/real-estate-tindivanam-highway), we verify approval before listing.
See the approved layouts we work with on [our layouts page](/our-projects).
